items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: George Brunus was in that band and Pansy Lane, Jack's son, and myself.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. George Brunus was in that band and Pansy Lane, Jack's son, and myself. I don't know just who else. But you see... About how old were you then? Oh, I was about 14. Jack lived on Port Street. And we used to go down there and stay overnight. We'd play a job Saturday night and stay at his house. And then we'd catch the Smokey Mary on a Sunday morning and go out and play at Millenburg. When you were kids at it?
Yeah, sure. Did you get paid?
